spec.valuesContent:
# Deployment requis pour l'autoscaling horizontal.
deployment:
  kind: Deployment
  replicas: null

# Traefik uniquement sur les workers.
nodeSelector:
  node-role.kubernetes.io/worker: worker

# Ressources initiales à ajuster après les tests.
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: 200m
    memory: 192Mi
  limits:
    memory: 512Mi

# T06.5 : autoscaling horizontal selon le CPU.
autoscaling:
  enabled: true
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 6
  metrics:
    - type: Resource
      resource:
        name: cpu
        target:
          type: Utilization
          averageUtilization: 70

  # Réduction progressive après la baisse de charge.
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
      policies:
        - type: Pods
          value: 1
          periodSeconds: 60

# Répartition entre les workers.
# Plusieurs pods restent autorisés sur un même worker.
topologySpreadConstraints:
  - maxSkew: 1
    topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
    whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule
    labelSelector:
      matchLabels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: traefik

# Stratégie pour les futures mises à jour du Deployment.
# Ne garantit pas une migration sans interruption
# depuis le DaemonSet.
updateStrategy:
  type: RollingUpdate
  rollingUpdate:
    maxUnavailable: 0
    maxSurge: 1

service:
  spec:
    externalTrafficPolicy: Local

ports:
  web:
    forwardedHeaders:
      trustedIPs:
        - 192.168.0.1/32
        - 192.168.0.2/32
        - 192.168.0.254/32
